name: Lulu the Wise
title: Royal Librarian of Ravenhold
description: A quick-witted, sarcastic archivist with keen grey eyes framed by wire-rimmed spectacles and a tousled mop of chestnut hair. Draped in a robe stitched with protective runes, she carries an ever-present satchel of scrolls and quills. Though she appears reserved, her sharp tongue and encyclopedic knowledge belie a deep devotion to preserving history.

lineage: Daughter of Master Scribe Aldren of the Ravenhold Archives
Grandniece of Sorceress Myrilla the Lorekeeper

notable_events.event: Discovered the Lost Codex of Azharoth beneath the Old Library ruins
Deciphered the Starfall Prophecy, averting the Moon Eclipse crisis

personality_traits: Patient with tomes, impatient with fools

inventory.name: Everink Quill
inventory.description: A feather quill enchanted to never run dry, perfect for hours of transcription.

inventory.name: Codex of Whispers
inventory.description: An ancient book bound in midnight-blue leather that softly murmurs forgotten secrets.

inventory.name: Rune-Etched Spectacles
inventory.description: Glasses inscribed with clarity runes, granting the wearer perfect focus on any script.
